title: Detailed anchor

<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <rect x="32" y="35" width="36" height="2.5" rx="1.25" fill="#D4A843"/>

  <!-- Left arm (curved) -->
  <path d="M 50 70 Q 30 70 22 52 Q 18 44 22 40" fill="none" stroke="#D4A843" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 50 70 Q 30 70 22 52 Q 18 44 22 40" fill="none" stroke="#F0C96A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Right fluke -->

  <path d="M 78 40 L 86 32 L 78 30 L 74 24 L 68 30 L 74 34 Z" fill="none" stroke="#F0C96A" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Bottom crown (curved base) -->
  <path d="M 38 76 Q 50 86 62 76" fill="none" stroke="#D4A843" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 38 76 Q 50 86 62 76" fill="none" stroke="#F0C96A" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Bottom point -->
  <polygon points="50,80 46,76 54,76" fill="#D4A843"/>
  <polygon points="50,80 48,76.5 52,76.5" fill="#F0C96A"/>

  <!-- Cross bar detail -->
